how: Betting signals score each side: sharp action, big money, PRO systems, money vs tickets, fade the public, reverse line move.
A pick is made only when the game fits a rule that is on, checked in order: favourite moneyline, then spread, then total.
Props are graded by stat and side (PASS, RUSH, REC, Over or Under) with a PLAY or LEAN edge; only rules that are on reach the card.
Every other prop is graded in the background so a rule can be promoted later.
notes: Price limits are locked: favourite moneyline no longer than -200, underdog +100 to +200. Game rules turn off at 20+ picks with negative season units and move to their stricter version after 30+ picks when it does better. Warnings: total_one_sided is negative over the last 3 weeks (6-9, -3.5u); total_one_sided is negative in Nov (2-5, -3.2u). Prop changes Nov 2: RUSH Over PLAY demoted (4-16, -12.5u); REC Over PLAY demoted (23-27, -6.4u); REC Under PLAY demoted (10-12, -3.1u); REC Under LEAN promoted (150-120, +13.8u). Nov 6 policy (Trina, Nov 5): active rules must be green season to date and this month. Switched: Total, money vs tickets or PRO systems on one side only off.

text: A rule is active only while its season to date and this month are both in the green (positive units).
Timing is unchanged: a rule can only switch off once it has 20+ season picks. The month counts once it has 5+ picks.
A rule turns off when its season units go negative, or this month goes negative on 5+ picks.
An inactive rule keeps being graded on every game it fits and turns back on when season and month are both green.
